chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn al-Mubarak, who said:
I said to Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام: Is sadaqat al-fitrah due upon a needy man? He said: There is no fitrah upon him.

key_terms.الْمُحْتَاجِ: a person in need or poverty
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ: it is not incumbent upon him

ai.seo_question: Is sadaqat al-fitrah obligatory on a poor or needy person?
ai.summary: This hadith states that sadaqat al-fitrah is not obligatory upon a needy person. It conveys a legal ruling in Shia fiqh that the financial duty of fitrah does not apply to one who is in need.
